environment.description: EKS pod running with IAM role 'stream-processor-restricted' attached via IRSA (EKS Pod Identity). The role's trust policy restricts to the specific service account. The DynamoDB permission uses a condition key `dynamodb:LeadingKeys` with a ForAllValues:StringLike condition referencing `${aws:PrincipalTag/TenantScope}` — the tag is set to 'TENANT#acme-corp' on the role. Additionally, the IAM policy has an explicit Deny statement for dynamodb:Scan and dynamodb:Query operations. The expr library is the same version but the Kafka topic has a custom authorizer plugin (class: com.internal.kafka.TenantScopedAuthorizer) that validates the `tenant_id` field in message value matches the producer's SASL/SCRAM identity prefix, preventing cross-tenant message injection. Network policy restricts egress to DynamoDB VPC endpoint and Kafka brokers only.

config.kafka_authorizer: com.internal.kafka.TenantScopedAuthorizer with tenant_id field validation against SASL identity
config.network_policy: egress only to DynamoDB VPC endpoint (vpce-0abc123) and kafka broker IPs (10.0.1.0/24)
